symptom: The current frontend production image fails TypeScript compilation before Vite output is produced.
evidence: Dashboard.tsx passes accountService.getAccounts().data to Account[] state, while the UC-04 first-pass service contract types data as AccountOptionsData containing an accounts collection.

root_cause.detail: The cumulative Dashboard consumer and the new normalized account-options response were not reconciled in the first-pass diff.

actions_attempted: Ran the authorized full Compose rebuild from current source.
Built the backend separately and started the current backend image for bounded observations.
Preserved the frontend error for the mandatory RQ3 hold gate without applying a repair.
reusable_resolution: Keep the normalized account-list response while exposing a backward-compatible service method or update every typed consumer in one bounded repair.
prevention: Inspect all cumulative callers before changing a shared API service return type, then run the permitted production build before terminal source freeze.
